_comment: What this workspace's spatial sections amount to as a study design, and
what each one's labels are. Read by scripts/assess_replication.py.
`labels` is one of: expert, transferred, none. It is reported rather than
tested -- the gate decides per section -- because a design can satisfy
replication and still support nothing in the validated lane.
